Religious dietary restrictions for Sawan month discussed

Ahead of the Sawan month in 2026, discussions have emerged regarding specific food items to avoid. Coverage highlights that onions, garlic, and other foods are traditionally excluded during this period. Additionally, the consumption of curd (dahi) during Sawan is being examined, with explanations referencing both religious and Ayurvedic principles.
